title: Mark Tasks Complete or Delete Them
user_story: As a user, I want to check off finished tasks or remove unwanted ones, so that my list stays organized and reflects only what needs attention.
acceptance_criteria: Each task in the list displays a clickable checkbox or toggle control.
Clicking the checkbox marks the task as complete by applying a visual change like strikethrough text or moving it to a completed section.
A delete button next to each task permanently removes it from the view when clicked.
All changes appear instantly without requiring a page refresh.
